verdict.rationale: Brex's own read APIs let you retrieve transactions, accounts, statements, users, trips and payments programmatically (brex-docs-4, brex-docs-55, brex-docs-56, brex-docs-57). Brex also documents a Zapier recipe that exports card transactions monthly to CSV (brex-docs-31), though that relies on a third-party tool. There is no evidence of a first-party, account-wide data export or offboarding flow. missing for 10: native export-all/offboarding feature, documented open export formats beyond third-party CSV recipes, coverage of all data types (receipts, policies, budgets history), independent corroboration of successful migration off Brex.
